name: Satsuki Yuu
source:
A one year older student and the president of Kirameki High School Student Union. She bears a number of resemblances to [url=/c1001]Shiori Fujisaki[/url], the main female lead of the first Tokimeki Memorial, and excels at everything she does. Due to the large load of work she is responsible for, she is very busy and seen carrying a folder all the time. Her closest friend is [url=/c1684]Kai Ryuukouji[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_4]Wikipedia[/url].]
